Get the details of a Fish Tree of Life release

Source: R/release.R
fishtree_release.Rd

Describes one tree release. Includes citation information and checksums.

Usage

fishtree_release(release = getOption("fishtree.release", .default_release))

Arguments

release

The release's id, from fishtree_releases. Defaults to `getOption("fishtree.release")`, or `"R2018"` if that is unset.

Value

A list with the release's `id`, `title`, `status`, `citation`, `doi`, `license` and `native_taxonomy`, and `files`, a data frame of its files.

See also

fishtree_releases to list releases.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
rel <- fishtree_release("R2018")
rel$citation
rel$files[, c("role", "url", "bytes")]
} # }
